details.name: Xaihi
details.quote: O Knowledge most ancient, lead us not into temptation but deliver us from the codes of malice... I am Xaihi, Endministrator. May you be enlightened.
details.infection: Oripathy positive (infected), based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Erudite: Linguist The focus of her research includes records of the mysterious Precursors to abstract and esoteric algorithmic scripts.
details.exp2d: Information Technology: Data Exchange Skilled in discourse with all manners of smart/non-smart devices and machines — ranging from access security interfaces to toasters.
details.hb1d: Technology: Signal Analysis and Processing The world's composition and how it works, signal inputs and outputs, and anything else named as a form of "technology" are the very fields of her pursuit.
details.hb2d: Mind Honing: Online Gamer The renowned master of "Algorithmic Checkers" aboard Dijiang. A mind kept cool in a low-temperature environment is essential to master this mathematical board game.
